label: Loading
description: The loading pattern for content that is not ready yet: skeletons shaped like the final layout for pages and lists, an inline indicator inside a busy control, or a thin progress bar for page navigation. Skeletons are used instead of spinners.
usage: Use skeleton for initial page, card, and list loads.
Use inline for a button or field that is saving.
Use bar for navigation between pages.
constraints: variant is skeleton, inline, or bar (default skeleton).
Nothing is shown for the first 200 ms, so fast responses do not flash.
Shimmer animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

binding.description: App-level pattern raised by the platform and elements, not placed in views.

accessibility.notes: The loading container sets aria-busy=true; when content arrives it is set to false and a polite live region announces "Loaded" only for user-initiated loads.

responsive: Skeletons follow the responsive layout of the content they stand in for.

examples.description: Skeleton while a record view loads
